review: Two develop reviews at round 9, implemented in parallel. (1) Sol: Reviewed Sol's round-9 request 'Build a simple shared rain shelter' (a learnable, reusable small shelter from obtainable local materials with a resting area for Sol and others) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 4): the registry already holds simple-shelter@1, whose contract protects exactly one person, so develop a general 'Assemble and maintain a multi-bay rain shelter' operation as an occupancy and composition extension of that construction machinery, not a reinvention. Smallest shared version: two adjacent, independently braced lean-to bays, each with the inherited 2 m x 2 m footprint and 2 m x 1 m covered floor, reached from one unobstructed open side; 13 branch, 4 vine and 6 bark per bay (26, 8 and 12 for two), no stone, no tools; 12 one-energy increments per bay (24 for two), start pays only the first and an energy shortage pauses without charge; per-bay commissioning; at most one fitting occupant per bay, occupants of other bays never disable a bay and two in one bay void it; the inherited 50% rain and 35% wind chill reductions within rain and wind 0.8, with no stacking, nutrition, air-temperature or rest bonus; the inherited wear law and 0.5 sound threshold per bay; inspect one round and 0.2 energy; builder repair and dismantling; cancel and death rules; no refunds. The specification is self-consistent, so this is a simplified but real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented shared-shelter@1 (scope long-ex15, package dependencies foundation-open@1 and simple-shelter@1, handler long.shared-shelter, learning 4) with modes start, resume, cancel, inspect, repair and dismantle. Start takes x, y (footprint centre), orientation, bays (2-4, default 2) and exact owned untreated whole units of 13N branch, 4N vine and 6N bark (stone or any other extra is refused); it checks the whole 2 m x 2N m footprint (within reach of the first bay, inside the world, ordinary '.' soil sampled every 0.5 m, waterlogging at most 0.1, no hazard, no overlap with solid or reserved objects, no living person) and a 1 m deep approach strip along the shared open side (inside the world, no open water, no solid object, at least as deep as the widest living body); it creates one persistent object per bay (kind shared-shelter-bay, reserved non-solid 2 m x 2 m footprint, shared structure id, bay index) and reserves the materials through collective-work escrow as carried, owned pieces split per bay and increment with the inherited simple-shelter split. Each paid increment (one round, 1 energy; the bound start action continues) revalidates the reserved pieces, reach to the bay being built, its ground and that no other person stands in it, then moves that increment's pieces into the bay as installed components with the same quantity, origin and age. Bays are built one after another with the inherited plan (2 posts, 3 ridge and braces, 3 ribs and binding, 3 roofing courses, final check); each bay's twelfth increment runs the inherited lateral-stability, binding-pull, roof-load (8.4 mass units per bay) and runoff checks plus an open-approach check and commissions that bay alone, or leaves it unverified, while the next bay continues. Too little energy, leaving reach, another person in the bay being built or waterlogging pause without charge; a round not worked pauses; a lost reserved piece stops the work and returns the survivors. Cancel (one round, no energy) returns uninstalled pieces once, removes bays without parts, leaves partly built bays unfinished and keeps commissioned bays; death drops uninstalled pieces where the person died and leaves installed parts. Inspect (anyone who studied; one round, 0.2 energy; a bay in reach as target) reruns the checks for every bay of the structure in reach, which can withdraw or restore each bay's protection, and records an unverified personal record of each bay's parts, condition, coverage, status, last weather and occupants. Repair (builder only; one round, 1 energy) replaces one installed increment of one bay with the same recipe of owned units, leaving the removed parts on the ground with their condition; protection returns only after a passing reinspection. Dismantle (builder only; one round, 1 energy per stage) returns the last installed stage of one bay to the ground with each part's condition and leaves the other bays untouched. Effect: a new physiology hook (long-shared-shelter-exposure.ts, chained after the simple-shelter hook in forest-environment.ts and inactive unless shared-shelter@1 is installed, so ex7-ex15 saved rounds are unchanged) adds back exposure x (rain x rainShield + wind x windShield) of the existing outdoor exposure chill for a living person wholly on one commissioned bay's floor, with rainShield = 0.5 x that bay's roof condition x the body share whose wind-slanted rain ray meets that bay's roof plane and windShield = 0.35 x roof condition x max(0, cos(orientation)); occupancy is counted per bay, so two people on one floor void that bay only, people on other bays change nothing, and a body across the joint fits no floor; weather above 0.8, pooled water, the open side to the wind, an unfinished, unverified or unsafe bay, an enclosure, or a simple shelter already covering the body give no protection, and nothing stacks; air temperature, hunger, nutrition and rest are unchanged. Each round every installed part of every bay wears by 0.0005 + 0.002 x rain + 0.002 x wind, and a part below 0.5 makes only that bay unsafe. Events: shared-shelter-started, -progress, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled, -failed, -test-failed, -bay-commissioned, -inspected, -deteriorated, -damaged, -repaired, -dismantled, -occupancy (who now lies on each bay floor, with positions and whether its protection checks pass) and -exposure-measured (weather, outdoor and avoided chill, occupants, withheld reason and the leak measures exposedBodyShare and roofWear), all carrying the structure or bay id. Each bay's data.view keeps the inherited drawing metadata plus structure id, bay ids, structure footprint, orientation, open approach, installed-increment mask, frame and roof condition, roof coverage, commissioning status, actual occupant positions and the protected occupant (set only when that bay's coverage and weather checks pass); bays reuse the existing simple-shelter drawing (footprint, ridge, installed roof courses, dashed until commissioned), so no viewer change was needed. No satisfaction rule, comfort benefit, practice milestone or other reward is added. Modeling assumptions: the inherited simple-shelter ones (one branch unit is one usable member, one vine unit 3 m of binding, one bark unit 0.5 m2 of roofing; ordinary dry soil permits hand-set posts; the constitutive values probe reveals; wind and wind-driven rain from +x with a slant of 0.25 x wind; rain wetting is represented through the rain part of the exposure chill because people have no wetness state; light weather is rain and wind at most 0.8; protection scales with roof condition; posts are not collision bodies; only the builder may repair or dismantle); bays are adjacent along the ridge with no shared or spanning members, built strictly one after another, and each is commissioned on its own final increment; 2-4 bays are accepted because one bay is the existing simple shelter; the open approach is a 1 m deep strip along the whole open side that must be inside the world, free of open water and solid objects and at least as deep as the widest living body, checked at start and at every commissioning, while people and reserved non-solid areas do not block it; inspection covers every bay of the structure within the inspector's reach; occupancy is reported only when the set of people on a bay floor changes; the experience review's optional comfort benefit and maintained satisfaction were not added because the specification's effect is physical protection only; communication, travel, consent and other people's occupancy remain their own message, navigation and other actions, each paid by that person. Reuse: long-simple-shelter.ts (plan, allocation, split, installation, release, refresh, checks and wear constants, now exported without behavior change), long-shelter-exposure.ts (geometry, limits, floor test and roof-ray test, now exported, and the simple-shelter exposure for the no-stacking guard), collective-work.ts, material-lots.ts, open-physical.ts, forest-climate.ts and open-foundation.ts; probe, gather, pickup and message remain the separate existing operations. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex15-shared-shelter.test.ts, 11 cases, materials gathered by real gather actions) cover the ex15-only scope and the simple-shelter@1 dependency, four-round study, 24 rounds and 24 energy with per-bay commissioning, exact conservation and load transfer, independent per-bay shielding equal to the body-temperature difference against an unprotected copy with unchanged air temperature, satiety and energy, a crowded bay losing protection while the other bay keeps it, no fit across the joint, no wind protection with the open side to the wind, withholding beyond the light-weather limits, pausing and resuming without charge (including an occupied bay), cancellation keeping a commissioned bay, rejected starts that spend nothing (one-bay recipe, stone substitution, wrong bay counts, bank soil, reach, a tree in the approach, an occupant, foreign materials, low energy), builder-only rules and inspection by others, wear disabling only the affected bay until exact repair and reinspection, per-bay stage-by-stage dismantling, and death. (2) Wren: Reviewed Wren's round-9 request 'Cultivate meadow roots' (a learnable, evidence-based way to plant or tend meadow roots so a finite food source can be replenished; a meadow-root patch visible near (10.1,12)) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 2): a general 'Establish and tend a cultivation trial' parameterized by source, exact owned propagule lot and quantity, reachable ground site and mode establish/tend/observe/resume/cancel/remove, with three one-round, one-energy establishment stages (prepare, place, cover and record), observation at the probe cost, tending at one round and one energy only with a supported intervention, irrigation only with real collected water, binding to the existing plant lifecycle and regeneration where present (an observation-only precursor otherwise), an 80-round inconclusive horizon, stalling or death from decay, drought, waterlogging or inadequate conditions, cancel, removal and death rules, harvest only through gather, and no benefit for requesting, studying or planting. Registry check: the long-ex15 registry (foundation-forest, foundation-open, foundation-expression, food-preparation@1, simple-shelter@1) has no planting operation; ex13 root-planting-trial@1 and ex14 cultivate-plant@1 are scoped to other experiments and are not modified. Unlike ex14's observation-only cultivate-plant@1, the existing ecology was checked first: under the development configuration open-ecology.ts already runs a conserved vegetative propagation lifecycle for non-woody plants (one parent stock unit becomes a seedling with stock 0, capacity min(4, parent capacity) and the parent's growth interval; it establishes once growth accumulated from actual temperature, light, soil moisture, season and waterlogging reaches 12, then regrows stock under the ordinary growth rule). The specification is therefore self-consistent and this is a simplified but real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented cultivation-trial@1 (scope long-ex15) with modes establish, resume, cancel, observe, tend and remove. Establish takes inputStackId (one whole owned unit; quantity must be 1), x, y and an optional target that must equal the unit's source. Before anything is spent it checks that the unit is a meadow-root unit, untreated (no drying, processing, combination or other represented treatment), unspoiled under the existing ageing law and gathered from a living root plant, and that the 0.25 m position is within reach, inside the world, on ordinary meadow soil (.) per the shared hand-preparation predicate, not standing water, waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, at least 0.6 m from any object, clear of people, and with fewer than 3 root plants or unfinished trials within 5 m. It reserves the unit through collective-work escrow (still carried, owned and ageing) and runs three paid stages of one round and 1 energy each (establish pays the first and the bound action continues): prepare the position; place the unit (it leaves the inventory with its origin, mass and age, owned by nobody and reserved for the position, so it can no longer be eaten or planted elsewhere); cover and record (the position object becomes a seedling of the existing ecology: resource root, stock 0, capacity min(4, source capacity), the source's interval, establishment 0, one seed unit, its parent and the law's 600-round first-dispersal delay). Each stage rechecks reach, site, unit and energy: too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pauses without charge, a round not worked pauses, and a lost or spoiled unit stops the work and returns survivors. After covering only ordinary simulation acts: the existing openPlants rule adds establishment from actual conditions, so cold, darkness, drought or waterlogging stall it; the buried unit keeps ageing under the existing food ageing law, and if it spoils before establishing the trial dies (interval set to 0, no further growth); when establishment completes the unit is absorbed (removed from the stacks, 1 unit and 0.4 mass recorded) and the position is an ordinary meadow-root plant whose stock regrows only under the existing growth rule, is harvested by anyone through gather at its existing cost, and may later disperse under the same law. At 80 planted rounds without establishing or dying the record reports 'inconclusive' and nothing else changes. Observe (anyone who studied; a trial or plant source in reach) runs the baseline probe observation (one round, 0.2 energy) and, for a trial, stores an unverified personal record of only visible state (lifecycle, elapsed rounds, visible stock, whether it sprouted, the unit's condition only while uncovered, soil and weather) and appends to the trial's observation log; monitoring an existing patch takes no food and adds no plant; information gain is only the probe's existing evidence-deduplicated change finding. Tend is refused with nothing spent because no supported intervention is represented (no competing plant can stand within the 0.6 m spacing, soil displacement is not represented, and no water collection or delivery exists for irrigation). Cancel (one round, no energy) returns an unplaced unit once and leaves a placed unit uncovered in the position, where it does not establish and eventually rots. Remove (planter only, one round, 1 energy) returns an uncovered or covered unit in its current condition, returns nothing for a dead trial and clears the position; it is refused for an established plant (no uprooting rule; harvest with gather). Death drops an unplaced unit where the person died and leaves placed or planted units to the ecology. Nothing spent is refunded. Events: cultivation-position-prepared, cultivation-unit-placed, cultivation-planted, cultivation-work-paused, -resumed, -cancelled and -failed, cultivation-trial-observed, cultivation-patch-observed, cultivation-trial-established, -died, -harvested and -removed. The object's data.view holds the trial id, source and lot, site bounds, quantity placed, stages completed, lifecycle, observation ticks and last observation, whether the unit is visible, and verified harvestable stock; a new small viewer drawing (cultivation-trial) shows a dashed soil position while worked, the unit only while uncovered, a covered mound with nothing visible while planted, a sprout with stock dots only after establishment and a withered mark when dead, and plants later dispersed from a trial fall back to the ordinary plant drawing. No satisfaction rule, practice milestone (cultivation-planted carries no qualified flag) or other reward is added. Modeling assumptions: meadow roots are the only supported species, because the existing propagation law treats one root stock unit as a vegetative propagule and the harvested organ is that unit; a harvested root unit stays viable exactly while it is whole, untreated and unspoiled under the existing ageing law, with no separate viability clock; only a covered unit establishes, so an uncovered placed unit never does; hand preparation is limited to ordinary meadow soil (.), the shared ex13/ex14 predicate, so forest floor (where the (10.1,12) patch grows) needs a different site; the position's area is the existing root plant footprint (radius 0.25) and depth is not represented; the site conditions are those under which the existing dispersal law starts a plant (soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m spacing, fewer than 3 same-resource plants within 5 m), extended to count unfinished trials; a planted trial has the same capacity, interval, establishment threshold, growth, waterlogging, seasonal and dispersal behavior as a naturally dispersed seedling of its source; the unit is absorbed into the plant at establishment, as a dispersed parent stock unit is; the position object has createdBy null like every plant, so observers see only public plant fields (the growth interval and dispersal schedule stay hidden) and the planter is kept in the trial record for planter-only removal; quantity is exactly one unit; harvest debits stock at gather's existing cost. Reuse: open-ecology.ts (seedling establishment, growth and dispersal, unchanged), forest-environment.ts (food ageing and spoilage), long-planting-site.ts (hand-workable site predicate), collective-work.ts (escrow, paid work, stop), open-foundation.ts (baseline probe and personal records) and the base gather handler; ex13 root-planting-trial@1 and ex14 cultivate-plant@1 are unchanged. Registration adds only this package's import and V7_PACKAGES entry in continuous.ts. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex15-cultivation-trial.test.ts, 8 cases, roots gathered by a real gather action) cover the ex15-only scope, two-round study and excluded vocabulary, the three paid stages with exact placement and conservation, hidden growth parameters, establishment equal to a natural control seedling on the same ground every round (82 rounds under this seed, past the 80-round inconclusive status), absorption of the unit, regrowth and harvest through gather, death of a rotted unit and planter-only clearing, rejected units and sites (forest floor, crowding, reach, quantity, spoiled, treated, energy, wrong source) that spend nothing, pausing, resuming and cancelling before and after placement, observation at the probe cost with an unverified record, refused tending, patch monitoring, and death before and after placement.
